# TestScript for 23-member-deprecation
# Asserts member deprecation: provenance-aware runtime warnings, help-screen
# markers, and exclusion from shell completion

# 1. Deprecated flag warning + parsed values still flow
exec member-deprecation --old value
stderr 'WARNING: flag ''--old'' is deprecated: use --modern instead'
stdout '--old\s+string\s+value\s+● cli --old'
stdout 'old="value" modern=""'

# 2. Deprecated subcommand warning
exec member-deprecation legacy
stderr 'WARNING: command ''member-deprecation legacy'' is deprecated: use deploy instead'
stdout 'legacy command executed'

# 3. Replacement subcommand stays silent
exec member-deprecation deploy
! stderr 'WARNING'
stdout 'deploy command executed'

# 4. Help screen marks deprecated members
exec member-deprecation --help
stdout '\[deprecated: use --modern instead\]'
stdout '\[deprecated: use deploy instead\]'

# 5. Deprecated members are excluded from shell completion
exec member-deprecation __complete export --
! stdout '"value":"--old"'
stdout '"value":"--modern"'

exec member-deprecation __complete export ''
! stdout '"value":"legacy"'
stdout '"value":"deploy"'

# 6. Deprecated subcommand's own help screen carries the banner above the usage
exec member-deprecation legacy --help
stdout 'WARNING: command ''member-deprecation legacy'' is deprecated: use deploy instead'
stdout 'Usage:'
